about_the_game:
In this game you'll explore colorful city streets on the eve of the Day of the Dead, unique jungle landscapes and ancient temples of a lost civilization. You'll even get a chance to look inside one of the pyramids. All along the way you will have to find all the hidden objects, so that the black-and-white world will be painted in color and come to life. You decide what items you want to find! Enjoy the game with atmospheric music. Suitable for the whole family

Game features:

- Option to choose the item you want to search for

- Increasing level of difficulty

- There is a hint

- Interactivity. Items can also be searched inside buildings

- The world is populated by inhabitants, each one has a story to tell

- Coloring levels

- 2.5D effect

- Possibility to break the piñata

Artist: Anikeyra
